# 360Configurator

> 360Configurator creates browser-based spatial product configuration systems for complex industrial products. The platform connects real-time 3D interaction with product rules, dynamic pricing, bills of materials and downstream commercial or production outputs.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://360configurator.com/): Platform overview, common capabilities and active deployments.
- [About 360Configurator](https://360configurator.com/about): Product initiative, engineering principles and approach.
- [Deployment paths and pricing](https://360configurator.com/pricing): Existing System subscription, Adapted System adaptation plus subscription, and Custom System implementation plus subscription. Scope and pricing are established after technical review.
- [Contact](https://360configurator.com/contact): Project enquiries and direct correspondence.

## Active configurator systems

- [Pergola and outdoor architecture](https://360configurator.com/configurators/pergola): Parametric pergolas, louvers, side enclosures, daylight, night lighting, accessories and live pricing.
- [Architectural roof and structure](https://360configurator.com/configurators/roof): Parametric roof typologies, dimensions, materials, measured quantities, BOM and CSV output.
- [Window and architectural profile](https://360configurator.com/configurators/window): Schüco AW CT 65 B2-6 profile configuration, glazing compatibility, opening mechanics, finishes and assembly diagnostics.
- [Industrial hall and warehouse](https://360configurator.com/configurators/hall): Parametric portal frames, structural spacing, envelope layers, industrial access and exploded assembly.
- [Solar roof and energy system](https://360configurator.com/configurators/solar): Address-aware solar context, roof and PV layout, real sun, consumption, storage and energy analytics.
- [Fence and perimeter system](https://360configurator.com/configurators/fence): Parametric perimeter layouts, resolved bays, panel systems, finishes, gates, foundations, BOM and live pricing logic.
